description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different quality metrics, specifically IFD, TagNum, and DEITA, in terms of their scores. The horizontal axis represents the quality metrics, while the vertical axis represents the scores, ranging from approximately 30 to 70. The IFD metric has a score of 41.90, TagNum has a score of 39.13, and DEITA has a score of 42.99. The DEITA metric has the highest score, followed by IFD and then TagNum. The chart also includes a dashed line representing the average score, which is approximately 63.98.
